Fix pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2607 (commit 835db73b9493, branch bug-c379-next-batch-story).

CHANGE. Deleted the four-line ticket_type == 'story' veto in src/rebar/_engine_support/next_batch.py; the preceding parent_ids_with_children check is already the correct container boundary. skipped_needs_planning is retained present-and-empty across NextBatchResult, to_json_dict, render_text, types.py, _mcp_models.py and next_batch.schema.json; it gained an explicit list[tuple[str, str]] annotation because mypy could no longer infer the element type once nothing appended to it. No change to types.py (generated) and no new mechanism.

TESTS. test_childless_story_needs_planning -- the codification of the defect -- was replaced by three oracles in tests/interfaces/queries/test_next_batch_behavior.py: (1) test_childless_story_is_an_executable_leaf (batched, itype == 'story', skipped_needs_planning == [], ready/next-batch parity via reads.ready_states, and schema validation of the JSON projection); (2) test_childless_leaf_is_batched_regardless_of_ticket_type, parameterized over story/task/bug/epic, pinning the ADR 0078 type-independence principle rather than the story case alone; (3) test_story_with_children_is_a_container_not_a_candidate, the negative control -- the container is absent from batch AND from every skipped_* bucket while its leaf child is batched.

DEFECT-SEEDED. Restoring the branch makes both story oracles fail: 'AssertionError: assert [] == ["lonely"]' and 'AssertionError: childless story was not batched / assert [] == ["leaf"]' (2 failed, 3 passed). Removing it again returns 29 passed.

GATES. Plan-review PASS (signed, no blocking findings; one advisory P6 ac-quality about compound AC lines). make lint exit 0; complexity ratchet active=35 new=0 increased=0 stale=14 -- compute drops 40 -> 39 against a baseline of 42, so it stays stale as expected. Mechanism ratchet active=682 new=0 attributable to this change (the 2 admitted entries are pre-existing scanner-lane ci_gates from origin/main 6125c5345f01). make typecheck clean over 755 files. tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py 31 passed. Blast radius across every next-batch-touching test file: 436 passed, 0 failed.
